_note: New Milestone A dialogue written for the 3D game (not in the Godot demo). Same format as data/dialogue/*.json: s = speaker, p = emotion, t = text, do = actions. Rowan Finch's lines: written by Claude, delegated by Adam on 2026-11-03.

rowan_morning.t: Morning, Kieran. Mind the cliff paths today. The wind's turning early.
The old stories say the Skyfarers could read the wind like a map.
The old stories say a great many things. They're good stories, lad. Let them stay stories.
Don't you ever wonder what's past the clouds?
Every spring I wonder if the mills will turn. That's plenty of wondering for one island.

rowan_inheritance.t: Maren tells me you had a letter. Elias's workshop, out on the Bluff.
He left it to me. I didn't even know he'd kept it.
Elias drew the finest maps this island ever had. It was the places he couldn't prove that worried folk.
Some doors stay shut for good reasons, Kieran.
Or because nobody ever tried the handle.

rowan_repeat.t: Mills turning, post moving, clouds where they belong. That's how Windrest likes it.
